mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in FEDFUNDS above 4.5% signals tightening monetary policy, raising discount rates and compressing equity valuations, leading to negative 20-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year window or 20-day returns in tightening periods are not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS rises >0.5% AND UNRATE falls >0.1pp in the same month, this signals strengthening labor market conditions despite Fed tightening, driving positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly positive when both conditions occur (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in FEDFUNDS below 1% during a late-cycle expansion signals accommodative policy, lowering discount rates and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly positive when FEDFUNDS <1% in late-cycle periods (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in PAYEMS exceeding 100,000 persons signals strong labor demand, boosting corporate profits and consumer spending, leading to positive 5-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: 5-day returns not significantly positive when PAYEMS crosses above 140,000 (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in INDPRO exceeding 1% signals robust business activity, enhancing corporate earnings and consumer demand, leading to positive 20-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly positive when INDPRO crosses above 95.5 (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When GDPC1 rises >2% AND UNRATE falls >0.2pp in the same month, this signals strong demand with improving labor market conditions, driving positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly positive when both conditions occur (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a sustained decline in CPIAUCSL below 2% signals deflationary pressures, lowering discount rates and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly positive when CPIAUCSL <2% in late-cycle periods (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in INDPRO over the past 6 months signals expanding business activity, enhancing corporate earnings and consumer demand, leading to positive 60-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: 60-day returns not significantly positive when INDPRO shows upward trend (p > 0.05).
